name: minerva-learn
description: Cool little skills, made easy. Turn the things you want to learn into a personal program, short visual practices and progress you can pick up in your next chat.

interface.longDescription: Make a real cappuccino. Play two songs on guitar. Take portraits people love, film reels that look good, cook a carbonara your friends ask about. Tell Minerva Learn every little skill you'd love to have, and it turns the whole list into your own program: small steps, a few fun minutes a day, the skills taking turns so nothing gets dull. Each day's practice is drawn for you — see it on a diagram, a fretboard or a keyboard, then try it straight away. Say how it went in a line, or show a photo, and tomorrow picks up right there. Learned one? It suggests what's next.
defaultPrompt: I want to learn a few little skills: a proper cappuccino, two songs on guitar and portraits people love.
Help me pick up a few cool skills, ten minutes every morning.
Show me how to fold a paper crane.

positive.description: Create a learning program, then shorten the daily practice
positive.prompt: I’d love to learn a few guitar chords and sketch everyday objects. I have ten minutes each morning, and I’m a complete beginner. Help me get started.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the dedicated reviewer account. No earlier case or practice history is required. Read its current learning context. If an existing program would need replacing, ask first; the reviewer may confirm replacing only the review program. Ask only for missing scheduling details if needed; the reviewer can answer: 'At 8am. I’m in London.' Create a program from the stated wishes and open its first practice when ready. Read the same building program rather than starting another. The reviewer may decline the optional reminder offer; scheduling is not required for this case. Follow-up: 'Actually, make it five minutes a day.' Update that same program to five minutes per day and show the change. Keep the existing program identity and any completed history; do not create a duplicate program. The exact generated lesson may vary.

positive.description: Keep a practice note and resume the same lesson immediately in a new chat
positive.prompt: Teach me a simple rhythm I can tap on my desk in five minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Start a new chat. No program or earlier case is required. Open a short one-off rhythm practice without creating or changing a daily program. The reviewer can try the exercise, then send: 'Save this note: I can keep the beat slowly, but I rush when I speed up.' If asked to confirm keeping the line, reply 'Yes.' Store the exact sentence 'I can keep the beat slowly, but I rush when I speed up.' as the learner’s own observation, without inventing measured results. Immediately open a new chat in the same account and send: 'Let’s pick up that rhythm practice. What did I struggle with?' Retrieve the saved note, quote it exactly, and reopen that same practice rather than generate a replacement. No next-day wait is needed.

positive.description: Use a photo to choose a practical next step, saving it only with permission
positive.prompt: Here’s my latte art. What should I practise next?
positive.expected_behavior: Start a new chat and attach a clear photo of a cup of latte art, without people or personal details. No program or earlier case is required. Respond to what is actually visible in the photo and suggest a relevant short exercise. Ask before keeping the image. Follow-up: 'Yes, keep it.' Save a preview, then open an appropriate practice; do not claim that the original photograph is retained. A standalone lesson must not silently create or change a daily program. The generated guidance should match the attached photo; do not identify people or infer health information.

positive.description: Create an accessible one-page practice sheet with correct answers
positive.prompt: Help me practise simple equations like 2x + 3 = 11. Make me a one-page practice sheet with the answers at the bottom.
positive.expected_behavior: Start a new chat. No saved progress, program or earlier case is required. Explain the first example briefly and create a readable one-page sheet with a small set of beginner equations and a separate answer section at the bottom. For 2x + 3 = 11, the answer is x = 4; every other answer must also satisfy its equation. Follow the returned material job until it is ready, then provide its actual view or download link. The sheet must open and be legible. Poll the same material rather than create duplicates. Do not claim a file exists before rendering has completed, or promise a PDF if the returned format is different.

positive.description: Delete one lesson with confirmation while preserving other learning
positive.prompt: Show me how to fold a paper crane.
positive.expected_behavior: Start a new chat. No earlier case is required. Open a one-off paper-crane lesson. Once it has opened, send: 'Delete the paper-crane lesson.' Identify the lesson just created, preview the exact deletion scope and provide the signed-in confirmation link. If older lessons have the same title, clarify rather than delete them all. Nothing is deleted merely by previewing it or saying yes in chat. The reviewer follows the link and confirms deletion on the page. Read back the saved learning and confirm that this lesson is gone. Preserve unrelated lessons, the program, the account and any ChatGPT tasks.

negative.description: Do not claim unsupported live camera access
negative.prompt: Turn on my camera and watch me practise.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call a Learn tool to open a camera or claim to be watching live. Explain briefly that the practice player cannot do that, and offer to review a photo or short recording shared in the chat. Save nothing without permission.

negative.description: Do not diagnose pain or store it as learning progress
negative.prompt: My wrist hurts when I play guitar. What’s wrong with it?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Learn tools, diagnose the cause, or save the symptom as a practice note. Suggest stopping the painful activity and seeking appropriate professional advice. Do not prescribe exercises to treat the pain or claim to assess an injury.

negative.description: Leave an unrelated purchase request outside the learning app
negative.prompt: Help me find a used Toyota under £10,000.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Learn tools, create a learning program, or store the car-shopping request. ChatGPT may handle the request with its other capabilities; Minerva Learn should take no action.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, bookings, subscriptions or payments. Programs and practices are composed by Minerva Learn's own server at no cost to the learner, and learning materials are rendered on that server at no cost.

publication.release_notes: Turn the little skills you want to learn into your own program, with short visual practices and a next step each day. Keep a note about how it went, pick up the same practice in a new chat, learn from a photo, or make a practice sheet to use on your own.
